In [[3963 BBY]], [[Zayne Carrick]], a dropout from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], began a campaign against [[The Crucible]], a massive and shadowy [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] organization. One of the first actions in this campaign resulted in a short but brutal '''skirmish''' in the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. After Carrick and his companion [[Jarael]] attempted to rescue eighty slaves from the [[Sungrazer cooperative]], Crucible [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Dace Golliard]] intercepted and engaged them. After a pitched battle between Golliard's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Gladiator (Crucible)|''Gladiator'']], and Carrick's motley ''[[Hot Prospect]]'', the Jedi was able to escape with a number of the now-freed slaves in tow.
